title: Protocol to establish cancer-associated fibroblasts from surgically resected tissues and generate senescent fibroblasts
protocol: Extract cancer tissues and paired noncancerous tissues from surgical resections.
Use a scalpel to extract CAFs from gastric cancer tissues.
Collect NFs at least 5 cm away from the cancer site.
Involve a trained surgeon in the separation of gastric cancer and adjacent normal tissue immediately after surgery.
Mince each collected material into small pieces approximately 2–4 mm in size using scalpels.
Prepare the enzyme mix by gently adding 4.7 mL of RPMI 1640, 200 μL of Enzyme H, 100 μL of Enzyme R, and 25 μL of Enzyme A into a gentleMACS C tube.
Wash dissected tissues at least three times using wash buffer.
Gently invert the tissue samples during washing to avoid damage.
Transfer washed tissues to culture medium and place on ice for further processing.
Mix minced samples of each material into a gentleMACS C tube containing the enzyme mix.
Tightly close the gentleMACS C Tube and attach it upside down onto the sleeve of the gentleMACS Dissociator.
Run the gentleMACS program h_tumor_01.
Detach the gentleMACS C Tube from the gentleMACS Dissociator after termination of the program.
Incubate each sample for 30 min at 37°C under continuous rotation using the MACSmix Tube Rotator.
Attach the gentleMACS C Tube upside down onto the sleeve of the gentleMACS Dissociator again.
Run the gentleMACS program h_tumor_02.
Detach the gentleMACS C Tube from the gentleMACS Dissociator after termination of the program.
Incubate each sample for 30 min at 37°C under continuous rotation using the MACSmix Tube Rotator.
Attach the gentleMACS C Tube upside down onto the sleeve of the gentleMACS Dissociator.
Run the gentleMACS program h_tumor_03.
Perform a short centrifugation at 300×g for 30 sec at room temperature (22°C–25°C) to collect the sample materials at the bottom of the tube.
Resuspend the sample in culture media and apply the cell suspension to a MACS SmartStrainer (70 μm) placed on a 50 mL tube.
Wash the MACS SmartStrainer (70 μm) with 20 mL of RPMI 1640 to collect any remaining cells lodged in the cell strainer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300×g at 4°C for 7 min.
Aspirate the supernatant completely.
Culture the cells in a 10 cm collagen-coated dish in 10 mL of culture media in a 37°C incubator with 5% CO2 and 95% humidity.
Expand the cells until they reach a confluency of 90% in a 15 cm dish.
Thaw primary fibroblasts and spin down at 210×g for 3 minutes to remove freezing media.
Culture primary fibroblasts in 10 mL of culture medium in a 10 cm plate.
Incubate cells in a 37°C incubator with 5% CO2 and 95% humidity for 3–5 days until the cells are 90% confluent.
Aspirate culture medium and wash cells once with 5 mL of 1×PBS.
Aspirate PBS and add 2 mL Accutase.
Incubate at 37°C for 3 min.
Lightly tap the plate to lift the cells.
If the cells are not all detached, incubate the plate at 37°C in increments of 2 min until all cells detach.
Dilute Accutase 1:5 using the culture medium.
Collect the cells into a 15 mL tube.
Spin down at 210×g for 3 min.
Culture primary fibroblasts in 10 mL of culture medium in a 10 cm plate.
Change the culture medium to cytokines containing medium for 24 h.
After 24 h, change the medium to culture medium without cytokines.
Culture the fibroblasts for 3–7 days without passaging.
Check changes in morphology for senescence validation.
Perform senescence-associated β-galactosidase (SA-β-gal) assay according to the manufacturer’s protocol using Senescence Detection Kit from BioVision.
Conduct western blot analysis with p16INK4a, p15INK4b and Lamin B1 antibodies.
Carry out a growth assay over a long period.
Perform immunofluorescence staining for γH2A histone family member X (γH2AX) and phosphorylation of the consensus target sequences (pST/Q).
Wait at least 10 days until the growth curve reaches a plateau for long-term growth assays.
Seed cells onto 96-well plates for the Incucyte S3 Live-cell assay.
Stain seeded cells with NucLight Rapid Red for live-cell imaging.
Follow Cell Signaling Technology’s standard protocol for immunofluorescence staining of γH2AX and pST/Q.
Incubate cells with primary antibody γH2AX at a 1:1000 dilution.
Incubate cells with primary antibody pST/Q at a 1:400 dilution.
Wash cells thoroughly to remove unbound antibodies.
Incubate cells with secondary antibody Alexa Fluor 488 at a 1:200 dilution.
Incubate cells with secondary antibody Alexa Fluor 594 at a 1:200 dilution.
Stain nuclei with DAPI solution for nuclear staining.
Wash cells to remove excess dye and antibodies.
